page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance allocates 8 dedicated virtual CPUs across 4 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, backed by 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Cache resources include 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache. The CPU features instruction extensions such as AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AES. It includes a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps, contains no integrated GPUs, and includes no bundled local storage, requiring attached cloud storage volumes.

Benchmark results show mixed compute capability typical of older Intel Xeon Skylake-generation platforms. The instance achieves average performance in general PassMark CPU evaluation (6992.04) and extended instructions (6075.96), alongside middle-tier uncached memory bandwidth of 40.27 GB/sec for reads and 35.09 GB/sec for writes. Conversely, Geekbench single-core (989.0) and multi-core (3785.0) scores sit in the lower quartile, alongside weak stress-ng compute results. Small language model inference on a 135M model achieves moderate throughput at 116.97 tokens per second for generation, whereas larger 7B models yield poor throughput at 5.21 tokens per second. Redis SET throughput measures 5.55 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides dedicated compute cores and AVX-512 capabilities for legacy x86 workloads without requiring payment for excess memory or idle local storage capacity. However, lower single-threaded processing and moderate network capacity present tradeoffs against newer CPU architectures. The instance is suitable for routine batch processing, build runners, distributed test environments, lightweight web servers, and mid-tier backend services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c5.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 16.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, the configuration includes AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI instruction sets, a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, zero GPUs, and no bundled local storage. In benchmark assessments, the system delivers mid-range uncached memory throughput and average PassMark CPU scores, while single-core execution and stress-ng throughput rank in the lower quartiles. Micro-model inference yields moderate generation rates, but heavier tasks such as 7B LLM generation show degraded performance. The instance provides balanced utility for predictable compute-bound processing, compilation nodes, standard application backends, and lightweight web serving where extensive memory allocations and local storage are unnecessary.
